entities.name: Steel Mother
entities.description: An earth goddess worshiped by the goblins of the Oxidda Chain on Mirrodin, believed to have created them.

entities.name: Sky Tyrant
entities.description: Believed by goblins to be the mighty hammer that forged the Steel Mother's body.

entities.name: Krark
entities.description: Goblin shaman who ventured into the Great Furnace to learn the truth of the Steel Mother and was executed for heresy.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: Place of pools of hot liquid metal where sacrifices were made.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain
entities.description: Region of Mirrodin where the goblins lived.

events.summary: Krark ventures into the Great Furnace to learn the truth of Steel Mother and is executed for heresy; his followers are excommunicated.
events.quote: The goblin shaman Krark ventured into the Great Furnace to learn the truth of Steel Mother and was executed for his heresy
